## **Why This Works for OSF Open Source Projects**
- **🔗 Project Awareness**: Contributors see how their PR fits into the bigger picture (Project, Milestone, Iteration).  
- **📋 Structured Process**: Encourages best practices with issue linking, testing, and documentation.  
- **🛠 Developer-Friendly**: Clear instructions for maintainers and reviewers.  
- **🎉 Encourages Participation**: Ends with a positive acknowledgment to make contributors feel valued.
